rationale: A unanimous, narrow clear-statement holding that PROMESA § 106(a) is forum-channeling (not an unmistakable abrogation of sovereign immunity) is most likely to be assigned to and kept by the Chief Justice, with Kagan as the next-most-likely author given her central reliance on Atascadero/Dellmuth/Sossamon. Separate writings are most likely from Thomas or Gorsuch to elaborate on immunity/territorial-status theory, and from Sotomayor to flag access-to-information concerns while joining the clear-statement result.
